repair.title: Iberian Lynx Rebounded
repair.summary: The Iberian lynx rose from 62 mature individuals in 2001 to 648 in 2022, with the total population now over 2,000.
repair.why_it_matters: Focused breeding, reintroduction, and habitat work pulled the world's rarest cat away from the edge.
repair.caveat: Road deaths, prey decline, and habitat fragmentation still threaten the recovery.
